auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: Selected entity metadata through GraphQL with target URN plus UI token subject and policy membership; system-wide authentication success does not grant entity access.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: PAT creation/revocation under Settings Access Tokens; verify policy privilege and expiry. GMS authentication config and UI session are separate.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
